notes.title: Upcoming multi-player update & price change
notes.notes:
First of all, we would like to thank everyone that has supported us so far !

The last months have been really busy, as we are moving towards the release of the multi-player version of METAL.

Our own dedicated servers should hold the first few hundreds of players, and everyone will be welcome to host their own.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32356549/c30174863843d8b78fa104cab94e2dacf8f01afc.jpg[/img]

As part of the update, we are also working to improve the graphics, menus and animations.

We are truly excited for this event, and we hope to see you in-game soon.

Sincerely,

The S.E.E.D. Team

notes.title: UPDATE 1802.06 released
notes.notes:
Hello !

We are happy to bring you another update.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=6pP2PKzBnHg

Here is a list of things that have changed :

- Improved AI path-finding
- Better animation control for AI
- Small performance optimization for all scripts
- Improved AI enemy detection
- Fixed some rag-doll issues (they were flying everywhere)
- A new game-mode called "War Zone"

We are especially excited about the War Zone mod. With this new addition, you can now fight as many enemies as you want to practice your combat skills. This will be useful to test any changes to the combat system.

Hope you enjoy, and stay tuned for the next update !

The S.E.E.D. Team

notes.title: UPDATE 1802.04 released
notes.notes:
Hello !

We have just updated the game today, with some minor changes to the menu and game-play.

Here are a couple of things we are currently working to improve : 

- Enemy NPC map navigation
- Humanoid NPC combat
- Player damage from falling
- Player death animation
- Graphics for blood, wood-chips, stone dust and other particles

Stay tuned !

The S.E.E.D. Team
